cvxopt_options.note: cvxopt library defaults, identical to author package src/upsa.py; E06 is an independent math implementation, not a copy of author QP code.

independence_statement: E06 independently implements K=XX', G_c=(K+c z I)^-1, a_t=1-(G_c 1)_t/diag(G_c)_t, the direct delete-row refit cross-check, the QP and trace scaling. Author src/upsa.py is imported ONLY as a first-window reference for the A-vs-B0 comparison and is never used to generate E06 B0/B1 outputs.
